source_documents.title: Anti-Kasha's Rule Emissive Switching Induced by Intermolecular H-bonding

reference_evidence_units.quote: TA initially shows a blue emission with a maximum at 416 nm together with a modest band around 465 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA (azulene-1,3,6-tricarbaldehyde)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neutral DMF, 5 x10^-5 M; excitation 365 nm; Figure 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TA initially has 416 and approximately 465 nm emission with QY up to 10% in DMF; small water fractions favor a strong band near 495 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: 10% is the initial DMF yield, not the water-added aggregate yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the absorption band of TA underwent a negligible change along with the alteration of the water fraction
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA
reference_evidence_units.statement: Nearly unchanged absorption leads authors to rule out H/J aggregation, excimer and exciplex mechanisms for the color switching.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source exclusion is spectroscopic, not universal proof that every aggregate excited-state interaction is absent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These observations further indicate the formation of hydrogen bonds between the TA and H2O molecules.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA-water interaction
reference_evidence_units.conditions: D2O titration in DMSO-d6; NMR aromatic upfield shift about 0.05 ppm; FTIR 11% versus 84% RH.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors infer water-to-TA hydrogen bonding from NMR shifts/broadening and lower-wavenumber carbonyl/OH vibrations.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: NMR Figure 3a main-text account; FTIR Figure S13 only reported in main, not personally inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intermolecular H-bond clusters are responsible for the photophysical switching whereas the further formation of bigger aggregates results in luminescence quenching
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA-water clusters
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Small-water clusters about 20 nm by TEM/24 nm by DLS; excessive-water aggregates about 400 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors distinguish water hydrogen-bond cluster switching from quenching by larger aggregates.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not generic aggregation-induced enhancement or evidence of a new intermolecular excited state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no emissive shifts could, however, be observed (only with intensity quenching) for the MA and DA systems with water added
reference_evidence_units.subject: Monoformyl MA and diformyl DA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Water addition to comparator solutions, main account of SI Figures S15-S16.
reference_evidence_units.statement: MA and DA quench but do not reproduce TA's emissive switching.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparator results delimit the triformyl response; SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: an absorption band with a wavelength of more than 600 nm can be observed without any near-infrared emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dual emission and excitation/lifetime comparisons before and after water addition.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors infer a dark S1 and assign the observed shorter-wavelength bands to higher states. Different excitation spectra and band lifetimes support distinct states; emission is oxygen-stable.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The dark-state/state-number assignment is interpretive; lifetimes and oxygen control are SI results reported in main only.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the S4 and S5 1nπ* states become lower-lying than the S3 π-π* state
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA and model hydrates
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TDDFT/B3LYP/6-31G(d), continuum solvent and explicit 2/4/6-water models; main methods p6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Hydration stabilizes n-pi* states and suppresses the S3-to-S0 branch, favoring S2-to-S0 emission; authors invoke some CT character for the red shift.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Approximate electronic-state interpretation, not proton transfer; explicit-water stoichiometries are models, not measured binding numbers.

reference_evidence_units.quote: No remarkable shift and switching of emissions can be observed when TA was exposed to methanol
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA with alternative hydrogen-bonding solvents
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Methanol and ethylene glycol controls, main account of SI Figures S24-S27.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Methanol does not reproduce switching; ethylene glycol also affects spectra little. Authors propose water-cluster amplification rather than any hydrogen-bond donor being sufficient.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI spectra not directly inspected; failure to switch is not proof of absence of all binding.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Similar emissive switching behavior was observed for a TA doped PVA/PAAS film
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA in polymer film
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 11%/84% RH exposure and water-drop/drying cycles, Figure 5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Humidity switches film emission reversibly; direct water addition eventually quenches it and drying restores the original state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Matrix is a moisture-responsive support; no independent matrix restriction-of-motion mechanism is established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: is here more pronounced than its rigidity effect
reference_evidence_units.subject: TA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Conclusion of solution and film photophysical analysis.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors prioritize electronic excited-state stabilization over hydrogen-bond rigidification.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Does not prove zero rigidity contribution, but does not establish RIM as the emission mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Water binds aldehyde acceptors in proposed hydrogen-bond clusters and controls emission. Broad host/guest family used for solvent-analyte binding, not a cavity-inclusion claim.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the source's limited CT character/stabilization interpretation, without converting the background ICT-sensor discussion into a stronger target claim.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Water changes dark/bright state ordering and emissive branch balance; this overlaps the anti-Kasha mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Main photophysical account is switching between S3- and S2-dominated emission, not S1 fluorescence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Authors explicitly favor the electronic over rigidity effect; no positive RIM label is justified from hydrogen bonds alone.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Water binds aldehyde acceptors in proposed hydrogen-bond clusters and controls emission. Broad host/guest family used for solvent-analyte binding, not a cavity-inclusion claim.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the source's limited CT character/stabilization interpretation, without converting the background ICT-sensor discussion into a stronger target claim.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Authors explicitly reject H/J, excimer and exciplex explanations for this switching. Their spectroscopic exclusion is bounded to the studied DMF/water response.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Water changes dark/bright state ordering and emissive branch balance; this overlaps the anti-Kasha mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer mechanism established by the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established for this target in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Main photophysical account is switching between S3- and S2-dominated emission, not S1 fluorescence.
